summary: Add read-only live workspace cleanup scanner for non-LLM and LLM-assisted multi-criteria triage

delivery.outcome: Implement standard/workspace_cleanup_scan.py (dependency-free Python 3.12 read-only live filesystem/Git/lease/process scanner emitting workspace-cleanup-snapshot/v1 and evaluating all 5 criteria profiles), wire closed end-to-end temporary-workspace conformance tests via standard/workspace_cleanup_scan_fixtures.py into standard/workspace_cleanup.py and standard/conformance.py, and document live CLI triage in v3 of docs/information/workspace-cleanup-standard.md.
nonGoals: Delete files, mutate Git repositories, or alter leases from workspace_cleanup_scan.py
Modify pinned git-lifecycle JSON Schemas, GBNF grammar, or .lifecycle profiles

architecture.decision: Keep the live observation probe in dedicated stdlib module standard/workspace_cleanup_scan.py (< 500 lines) and isolated fixture tests in standard/workspace_cleanup_scan_fixtures.py (< 500 lines), reusing workspace_cleanup.py evaluators and invoking live tests from workspace_cleanup.self_test().
interfaceChanges: Add read-only CLI and library APIs scan_workspace and evaluate_live_workspace in standard/workspace_cleanup_scan.py
architecture.rollback: Revert commit adding standard/workspace_cleanup_scan*.py and restore v2 of docs/information/workspace-cleanup-standard.md.

commands: ruff check --no-cache standard/workspace_cleanup.py standard/workspace_cleanup_llm.py standard/workspace_cleanup_fixtures.py standard/workspace_cleanup_scan.py standard/workspace_cleanup_scan_fixtures.py
